summary: Frontend-only Playwright retest of Slipstream (Expo Web) at mobile viewport 375x667. All 4 routes (/, /run, /garage, /prestige) render cartoon UI without red screens. HOME shows coin pill, home-mute-button (icon toggles 🔊↔🔇), token pill, SLIPSTREAM title, daily-challenge-card with 'Keep riding to complete it!' hint (daily-claim-button correctly absent on fresh save), and home-ride/garage/prestige buttons. Navigation works to all 3 routes. RUN: run-start-button starts run, run-score increments (1 → 94 in ~2.5s), run-player/run-brake-button/run-pause-button/run-play-area all render, tapping LEFT half of run-play-area moves player left (203.5 → 120.4), tapping RIGHT half moves right (120.4 → 202.4) — PREVIOUS ITERATION 1 BUG IS FIXED via Gesture.Race(pan, tap). run-pause-button returns to Home. GARAGE: BIKE SPEC bars, coin+token pills, 'No crates yet' empty state, grid-tile-0 & grid-tile-1 render, garage-export-button disabled with '155cc FI engine' label, garage-back → /, garage-ride → /run. PRESTIGE: coin+token pills, 'Permanent Upgrades' with upgrade-grid5/scoreMult/handling/higherTier cards; tapping upgrade-buy-scoreMult with 0 tokens shows 'Not enough Syndicate Tokens' toast and tokens stay 0; prestige-back → /. Only one benign console warning: 'The play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()' from expo-audio HTMLAudioElement (non-fatal, no crash). No expo-audio, react-native-svg or expo-image crashes.

issues: SLIPSTREAM title renders as 'SLIPSTRE…' truncated on 375px viewport because adjustsFontSizeToFit is a no-op on RN-Web. Consider lowering base fontSize or removing numberOfLines={1}. Cosmetic only. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:79-81

action_items: Optional: fix SLIPSTREAM title truncation on 375px web viewport (adjustsFontSizeToFit doesn't work on web) — reduce fontSize from 52 to ~44 or remove numberOfLines={1}.
Optional: silence benign expo-audio pageerror 'play() request was interrupted by a call to pause()' by awaiting pause before starting a new play (audio.tsx startEngine/startMusic). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: run.tsx now uses Gesture.Race(pan, tap) — tap-to-lane change works on web. Good fix.
run.tsx is still ~610 lines mixing HUD/overlay/summary/gesture — consider splitting for maintainability.
audio.tsx: expo-audio createAudioPlayer sources are static requires; on RN-Web, rapid play() after pause() emits a browser AbortError warning — wrap in .then().catch(()=>{}) or await previous state.
seed_data_creation: None. Fresh on-device save (BEST 0, RUNS 0, TOKENS 0, no crates, 4×4 grid with seeded tiles).
